nom: Lancôme UV Expert Supra Screen Invisible Sunscreen Serum SPF 50+

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the sunscreen feels hydrating and non-greasy under makeup, including one in cold weather who found it kept skin moisturized all day, though one reviewer with dry, freckled skin found the protection didn't last and needed more frequent reapplication.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin are split: two describe it blending in nicely and working well, while one with combination, acne-prone skin found it too greasy and reported clogged pores and frequent breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation or breakouts and call it soothing or gentle, including some whose skin usually breaks out from sunscreen or other Lancome products, though one reviewer notes a friend with sensitive skin felt a burning sensation on application.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who states her age, 48, reports the sunscreen keeps her skin hydrated without greasiness and works well under makeup, and recommends it especially for dry to normal skin types.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention the sunscreen's anti-aging or wrinkle-related claims; one who used it as a daily moisturizer says it hydrated her skin but was undecided on whether it reduced wrinkles, while others credit it generally with anti-aging benefits without describing a specific visible change.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the formula as hydrating, with several saying they can skip a separate moisturizer entirely and one noting it avoided the dry, chalky finish other sunscreens leave; no reviewer reports a drying effect from this product.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report the sunscreen prevented sunburn and redness even after extended sun exposure, with one noting visibly less redness and sun damage since starting use; no reviewer reports redness caused by the product itself.
concerns.barrier: The large majority of reviewers report zero irritation, stinging, or allergic reaction and call it gentle even around the eyes; one reviewer notes a friend with sensitive skin experienced a burning sensation on application.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers with sun-related dark spots and dullness report the niacinamide and vitamin C in the formula helped fade dark spots and even out skin tone with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe acne-prone or sensitive skin, report no clogged pores or breakouts; one reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin, however, found it too greasy and experienced clogged pores and frequent breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Nearly all reviewers describe the formula as non-greasy and lightweight even under makeup, though one reviewer with combination skin found it too greasy and prone to clogging pores.

aspects.libelle: Wears smoothly under makeup without pilling
Sleek, travel-friendly packaging with easy-dispense applicator
Noticeable floral fragrance bothers some users
Considered pricey for the bottle size

extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this sunscreen, but it ended up being way too greasy for my combination skin. After regular use, I noticed clogged pores and frequent breakouts. If you're acne-prone, I'd steer clear — it just doesn't sit well on the skin.

extraits.titre: Great sunscreen but needs many re-applies
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have dry skin and this sunscreen works well under makeup and doesn't feel heavy or greasy. The texture is smooth and hydrating, which is great for dry skin like mine. However, if you have freckles or pigmentation, it doesn't give long-lasting protection, I noticed my skin gets tanned easily if I don't reapply often. It's a nice sunscreen, but not the strongest in sun defense for sensitive or freckled skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Lancôme UV Expert Supra Screen Invisible Serum Sunscreen SPF 50+ for a few weeks, and I'm really impressed. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving a white cast or greasy feeling, which makes it perfect under makeup. It feels more like a serum than a typical sunscreen and gives my skin a smooth, hydrated finish. I also love that it doesn't clog pores or irritate my sensitive skin. The packaging feels sleek and luxurious, and a little goes a long way. It provides great protection even on long sunny days, and I've noticed less redness or sun damage since I started using it.

extraits.titre: One stop solution for serum and sunscreen
extraits.texte: I'm outdoors a lot in the summer, and my skin reflects that, dark spots, dullness, and uneven tone. But Lancôme's Supra Screen SPF 50+ is seriously a game-changer. It feels more like a serum than sunscreen, lightweight, invisible (no white cast), and leaves a radiant glow. It hydrates like crazy (my skin actually feels soft all day), and the combo of niacinamide, vitamin Cg, and hyaluronic acid has helped fade some dark spots already. These are my favorite ingredients in any skincare products. Plus, I love the packaging! The compact, sleek bottle with that glowy Lancôme logo? Super cute and totally travel-friendly. The only thing I wish could be improved is the longevity, I can't reapply serum based sunscreen every 2-hours on my makeup. Now in that case, I have to invest in a setting spray that has spf 50+. Overall, an amazing product to minimize skincare routine steps.

extraits.titre: Finally Found My Holy Grail Sunscreen!
